title: Guest Service Fee Kept on a Late Cancellation
content:
# Guest service fee on a late cancellation — terms

**Term.** Roamhaven keeps part of its fee on the refunded amounts of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category when a cancellation comes late, because the booking held the listing off the market:

- a cancellation dated on or after the check-in date returns 50 percent of the fee on the refunded fee base;
- a cancellation dated before the check-in date but fewer than 7 calendar days before it returns 75 percent of it;
- any earlier cancellation returns all of it.

The share returned applies to the refunded fee base before the fee percentage is applied. Days are whole calendar days from the cancellation date (the date part of the cancellation time) to the check-in date recorded on the stay.

## Timeline (hypothetical check-in date D)

| Cancellation dated | Calendar days before check-in | Share of the fee on the refunded fee base returned |
|---|---|---|
| D minus 8 | 8 | all (100 percent) |
| D minus 7 | 7 | all (100 percent) — not fewer than 7 |
| D minus 6 | 6 | 75 percent |
| D minus 1 | 1 | 75 percent |
| D | 0 (check-in date) | 50 percent |
| D plus 3 | after check-in | 50 percent |

## Illustration (hypothetical refunded fee base of 800.00, fee percentage 14.20%)

| Cancellation | Base after the share | Fee refund |
|---|---|---|
| 10 days before check-in | 800.00 | 113.60 |
| 3 days before check-in | 600.00 | 85.20 |
| on the second night of the stay | 400.00 | 56.80 |
